scope: All resource names used by the 29 scenarios in the pinned stock powerscntbl.xml; declarations do not prove writable nodes or physical effect.
parser_behavior: cmdSetting resolves special metadata, XML control-table entries and native registry entries. Unknown names return -1; Scn_cmdSetting still appends the returned resource ID. Do not infer hardware action from the XML name.
validation_limits: Static mapping of stock files and remote disassembly.
Native registry recovered by constant propagation; active scenario callback IDs cross-checked against ELF references.
Control-table node accessibility is checked by the stock HAL at initialization and is not established offline.
All 100 scenario resource names also checked through actual stock cmdSetting in an ARM64 emulator; native bounds synthetic, no driver callbacks executed.
callback_semantics: Native registry offsets +0x30 and +0x38 are apply and release callbacks, not minimum/maximum limits. perfScnUpdate arbitrates active votes and invokes the release/default callback when the last vote disappears.
